Testable rewritten requirement: The system shall create one reminder for each new valid booking.
The system shall accept vehicle, workshop, date and service type through /book.
The system shall reject booking dates earlier than the server date.
The system shall prevent a second Sent reminder for the same booking.
The system shall display weekday utilisation counts on the dashboard.
The system shall allow a customer to opt out of marketing reminders.
The system shall list 40 seeded workshops.
The system shall expose /health with HTTP 200 when the database is available.
The system shall update reminder status to Sent after successful processing.
The system shall filter reminders by their scheduling status.
Health response time shall remain below 500 ms for 95% of 50 checks.
The app shall run in a supported desktop browser.
The database shall retain seeded and newly created records between restarts.
The system shall not log customer marketing consent in plaintext.
The prototype shall support all Selenium flows without manual database edits.
